sloka: वचोभिरग्र्यैर्हर्म्यस्थाः क्षितिस्थाश्च ववन्दिरे ।नूनम् नन्धिति ते माता कौसल्या मातृनन्दन ॥२-१६-३९॥
transliteration: vacobhiragryairharmyasthāḥ kṣitisthāśca vavandire ।nūnam nandhiti te mātā kausalyā mātṛnandana ॥2-16-39॥

translations.english: O Joy of your mother (Rama) on seeing you having successfully acomplished the purpose of your journey (life) by securing your father's kingdom, your mother Kausalya will surely be delighted.
